sections.heading: What is “lenni”?
paragraphs: Hungarian uses the verb “lenni” to express the idea of “to be” when talking about existence, location, or identity. It is irregular and must be learned separately.

sections.heading: Key Points
list: The verb “van” is irregular and behaves differently from other Hungarian verbs.
The negative form uses “nincs / nincsenek” instead of “nem van / nem vannak”.
